guideDescription: Complete these steps to learn the basics of PigCloud. Your progress is saved automatically.

guideStepTerminalDesc: Click the terminal icon in the toolbar to run CLI commands without leaving the app.
guideStepMoveDesc: Select an item and choose Move to pick a destination, or drag it onto a folder in the grid or sidebar.

subscriptionCreditsA1: Credits are weighted, not raw token counts: each word the assistant writes costs about five times one of yours, and context it re-reads from its cache costs a tenth. A plain question is cheap; having it read a large file or run several commands in one turn costs many times more.

subscriptionFaq1Q: Can I change my plan at any time?
subscriptionFaq1A: Yes. A switch to another paid plan applies immediately, with the price difference charged or credited at once. Turning off auto-renewal takes effect at the end of your billing period.
subscriptionFaq2Q: What happens to my files if I downgrade?
subscriptionFaq2A: Your files stay and downloads keep working. If they exceed the new plan's storage limit, uploads stop until you free up space; after 30 days over the limit new shares and public links stop too, and after 180 days content above the limit can be removed once we have emailed you a final notice.
subscriptionFaq3Q: How do I cancel my subscription?
subscriptionFaq3A: Choose Stop renewal on this page or under Settings › Subscription. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, then your account moves to Free.
subscriptionFaq4Q: How does billing work with expansion packs?
subscriptionFaq4A: Your plan and any expansion packs are combined into one charge per billing period. On monthly billing, a Pro plan plus a 50 GB expansion pack is one payment each month; on an annual plan the packs are prepaid with the year. You can add or remove packs at any time.

assistantGreeting: Hi! I'm Max, your PigCloud assistant. Ask me anything about uploads, sharing, security, or navigating PigCloud!
settingsAssistantEnabledDesc: Show the assistant bubble on the cloud page
settingsAssistantAdvancedDesc: Allow Max to run commands on your account
settingsAssistantAdvancedWarning: Heads up: advanced features cannot preserve full file and account anonymity by design. Any command you enable can surface real data: file and folder names, the contents of files you ask Max to open, short excerpts from other files a listing or search turns up, account details via wh (including email and two-factor status), storage usage via du/st, current folder via wd, your activity feed via ac, and a public link's URL and access token via pl. All of that leaves the end-to-end encryption boundary and is sent to Anthropic's Claude API for processing.

landingFaqSubtitle: What you should know about PigCloud's encryption, storage, and pricing.
landingFaq1A: No. PigCloud uses end-to-end encryption, meaning your files are encrypted on your device before they reach our servers. We never have access to your encryption keys and cannot decrypt your data. Even file and folder names are encrypted.
landingFaq2Q: What happens if I forget my password?
landingFaq2A: Your password derives the key that protects your private encryption key. If you forget your password, you can use the recovery key that was generated when you set up your account. Without either your password or recovery key, encrypted files cannot be recovered; this is by design, as it means no one else can access them either.
landingFaq3Q: Is there a file size limit?
landingFaq3A: Individual files can be up to {maxUploadSize}. Files are encrypted and uploaded in chunks, so even large uploads are reliable. Paid plans offer faster upload and download speeds.
landingFaq4A: All files are stored on dedicated servers in Falkenstein, Germany, under strict EU data protection law (GDPR). We don't use third-party cloud providers for storage. Two things do reach outside: requests travel through Cloudflare's global network, which sees connection metadata and encrypted payloads, and the optional Max assistant sends the data you share with it to Anthropic's Claude API in the US.
landingFaq5Q: What makes PigCloud different from other cloud storage?
landingFaq5A: PigCloud combines true end-to-end encryption with a full-featured file manager, a powerful CLI tool, and transparent pricing. Most cloud providers either lack E2EE entirely or bolt it on as a premium feature. With PigCloud, every file is encrypted by default, on every plan, including the free tier.
landingFaq6Q: How does sharing work with E2EE?
landingFaq6A: When you share a folder, PigCloud re-encrypts the file keys for the recipient's public key. The server facilitates the exchange but never sees decrypted data. Public links embed the decryption key in the URL fragment, which is never sent to the server.
landingFaq7A: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) as well as SEPA Direct Debit, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more through our payment provider Stripe. All payment processing is handled securely by Stripe; we never store your card details.
landingFaq8Q: Can I use PigCloud from the command line?
landingFaq8A: Yes. PigCloud has a full-featured CLI tool with 40+ commands that supports the same E2EE as the web interface. It's available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. There's also a browser-based web terminal you can use without installing anything.
landingShowcaseTitle: A cloud that does more, without seeing more
landingShowcaseSubtitle: PigCloud comes with a full toolkit the giants don't ship, all under the same end-to-end encryption.
landingShowcaseAssistantDesc: Ask Max, your personal pig assistant, to navigate folders, find files, run CLI commands or just answer questions. Granular permissions let you decide exactly what it can do without asking.
landingShowcaseChatDesc: Talk to friends and share files right inside your cloud. Replies, Markdown, read receipts, edits, deletions, all end-to-end encrypted. The server only ever sees ciphertext.
landingShowcaseUploadDesc: Drag-and-drop or paste any folder. PigCloud chunks, encrypts and uploads in parallel with a live progress queue, resumes after network drops, asks before overwriting, and ships every file with a post-quantum integrity signature, all without the server ever seeing plaintext.
landingShowcaseMountTitle: Mount your cloud as a drive
landingShowcaseMountDesc: On Windows, macOS and Linux, mount PigCloud as a real drive letter through the CLI. Files stream and decrypt on demand. Edit and save right from your file manager.
landingShowcaseCustomizationDesc: Pick from four built-in themes or design your own palette. Six fonts including OpenDyslexic. Customize backgrounds, sound effects and your assistant's tone. Keyboard shortcuts help you move around.
landingShowcaseAudioTitle: A floating audio player that follows you
landingShowcaseAudioDesc: Double-click any audio file to open a persistent waveform player that stays put as you browse folders. Loop, speed control, volume, prev/next, and playback resumes after a page reload.
landingIncludedLabel: On every plan, including the free tier:
landingCompareBody: Most cloud providers either lack end-to-end encryption entirely or paywall it on top of an already paid plan. PigCloud was built differently: every account, including the free tier, gets the full encryption stack and every feature.
landingCompareBullet1: The free tier gets the same end-to-end encryption as Pro and Scale; encryption is never a paid add-on.
landingCompareBullet2: File and folder names are encrypted, not just contents; the server cannot tell what you store.
landingCompareBullet3: No ads, no tracking, no AI training on your files, no scanning your data for marketing; by cryptographic design, not by promise.
landingCompareBullet4: Four source-available codebases on github.com/pigtech-de (CLI, desktop app, mobile, TEE scanner) you can audit and rebuild yourself.
landingFaq9Q: How does PigCloud check uploads for malware if files are encrypted?
landingFaq9A: Your browser encrypts the file, then grants an isolated scanner service on the server a single-use key for that file. The scanner decrypts only in memory, runs format validation, ClamAV signatures, and YARA rules, then signs the result; plaintext is never written to disk and the web application never sees it. On SGX-capable hardware the scanner runs inside an attested enclave.
landingFaq10Q: Is PigCloud ready for quantum computers?
landingFaq10A: Yes. Sharing and key exchange use a hybrid scheme combining classical X25519 with ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203), the post-quantum key encapsulation algorithm. File-content integrity uses a hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-44 (NIST FIPS 204) signature scheme. Even if a future quantum computer breaks one classical primitive, both confidentiality and authenticity of your data remain intact.

landingShowcaseSyncDesc: Pair local folders with cloud folders and the desktop app keeps both sides current in the background. Conflicts ask before overwriting, ignore patterns skip what you don't want, and the tray icon shows what's happening.
landingShowcaseVersionsDesc: Edits and re-uploads snapshot the previous state automatically. The built-in compare view shows word-level diffs between any two versions, lets you adopt single blocks back, or restores the whole file with one click.
